claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: One-time spectral relaxation does not imply two-time/occupation scaling. The nontrivial factor of two in the memory term produces a rate threshold r=mu absent from the cited first-marginal exponents. Fixed-location reset correlation formulas do not imply it because memory-sampling conditional expectation equals B_t/t, not a fixed reset state.
